# LoftOS

> White-label gaming café software for gaming lounges, PlayStation arenas, cafés, and entertainment centers.

## Product
LoftOS is a multi-tenant operating system that combines gaming session billing, booking software for gaming lounges, membership management, restaurant POS, QR ordering, kitchen display, inventory, staff permissions, and analytics.

## Primary audiences
- Gaming café and PlayStation lounge owners
- Esports and entertainment venue operators
- Café and restaurant floors attached to gaming spaces
- Multi-location / white-label entertainment networks

## Core capabilities
- Gaming café software: start, pause, extend, and settle timed sessions with food add-ons, overtime, GST, and branded receipts
- Booking software for gaming lounges: public slot bookings, capacity rules, admin block-outs, tournaments, and events
- Membership management software: memberships, prepaid packs, guest profiles, and repeat-visit workflows at checkout
- Restaurant POS, QR menus, kitchen display, inventory audit trail, expense ledger, and multi-branch control

## Pricing (INR)
- Starter: ₹2,999/month
- Pro: ₹5,999/month
- Business: ₹9,999/month
- 14-day free trial available
